digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Agent-driven dev loop trends cannot be queried because event-sourced history exists but lacks an aggregation and metrics layer.
Tier-C blindspots (env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug outcome classification) leave no durable trace in the event store and require passive instrumentation to capture them.

Bug-provenance auto-derivation via blame is best-effort and non-authoritative; it blames the parent of the fixing commit and is skipped when file impact is ambiguous or blame cannot resolve a single commit.
The metrics command must report all registered metrics with either a value or a structured unavailable reason, supporting date-range filtering and multiple output formats.
Bug-close friction must not increase; the required free-text reason is replaced (not supplemented) by a bounded close_class enum persisted on the STATUS event.
Backfilled and classified metrics must be labeled with source and confidence, segregated from authoritative structural series, and never aggregated into metrics treating them as authoritative.
